description: A new feature or tool, end to end: requirements, plan, build, tests, docs, pull request, merge, summary. ref = the repo or folder (optional).

steps.title: Requirements written (board req): what it must do, for whom, the limits
Plan: the design and the files it touches
Tested: new tests, the suite, and the real thing run
Summary written (board summary): what shipped and what was left out
